candidate.label: T01-A
candidate.summary: Transit signal of the known planet WASP-18 b in the sector-2 light curve of TIC 100100827. The closed T01 guided known-planet recovery experiment recovered its period and phase. Imported from the experiment record as an external proposal. Development data. Not platform evidence.

notes.body:
Quoted from the closed T01 record, experiments/tess-known-planet-recovery/README.md. The import adds no judgment.

Outcome:
"Closed with successful guided period and phase recovery for both selected planets."
"All conditions passed for both targets."

Results table row (planet, reference period in days, recovered period in days, relative period error, phase error, sampled events), and the depth sentences:
"| WASP-18 b | 0.941452520 | 0.941384909 | 0.00718% | 0.960 minutes | 28 |"
"The fitted box depths are 0.9474% and 0.2189%, respectively."
"Their formal signal-to-noise ratios are 652.4 and 46.0."

Limits:
"This is a guided recovery test, not a blind search or independent population evaluation."
"This result supports the brightness-series workflow. It does not validate that preparation for depth measurements or discovery searches."
"These ratios assume the supplied independent errors. They do not measure false-alarm probability or discovery confidence."
"The phase errors describe a coarse box search, not precision transit timing."
"No physical transit model, pixel-centroid check, blend assessment, or negative sample enters this experiment."
"| WASP-18 b | 0.99897% | 0.94737% | 0.9483 |"
"WASP-18 also has a substantial odd/even depth difference relative to the reported formal errors."
"The archive marks the selected WASP-18 reference with a transit-timing-variation flag."
